system.description: Humorless goddess of death as the exact, proper end of life; those who dodge or deny death offend the natural cycle.
system.summary: Humorless goddess of death as the exact, proper end of life; those who dodge or deny death offend the natural cycle.
commandments: Do not pity those who suffer and die; death is life's natural close.
Humble the proud who try to escape fate and punish arrogance.
Walk the shadows, avoiding both zealous good and utter evil.
directives: Death is life's intended end and must not be avoided.
Each being has a fate; she allows some change in exchange for the soul at the proper time.
All are equal before death, and knowing this keeps everyone humble.
Mortal life, in step with death, surpasses immortality.
Every dead being is owed funeral rites for her glory.

cults.name: Cannibals
cults.summary: Secretive cults honoring the dead by ritually eating part of the body, mostly as a burial custom.

cults.name: Undead Hunters
cults.summary: Devotees with ritual gear who destroy undead and necromancers, heroes in a crisis but seen as paranoid in calm times.
